title: The Bond Market is Having a Historical Meltdown
speaker: Tom and Mike (StockedUp hosts)

macro_themes.view: Treasuries are in one of the worst bear markets in history (10y 5.29%, 30y 5.61%) and rising yields are driving the stock sell-off.
Williams' 'no urgency' comment cut October hike odds from ~70% to ~49%, sparking a late-day reversal; markets price four more hikes by June 2027.
The US-Iran war is fuelling inflation and is escalating rather than de-escalating, a continuing risk for stocks.
S&P breadth is at extreme lows (~25% of stocks above 50-day MA); similar NYSE breadth-momentum signals led to S&P declines three weeks later in 6 of 7 cases.
Sept 30 is historically the best buying point in a midterm year.
